question: What is the common biological phenomenon by which one organism produces biochemicals that influence the growth, survival, development, and reproduction of other organisms known as?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Allelopathy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Allelopathy** refers to the biological phenomenon by which one organism produces biochemicals that influence the growth, survival, development, and reproduction of other organisms.
 
• The biochemicals involved are called **allelochemicals** and can have beneficial or detrimental effects on target organisms.
 
• Allelopathy is commonly observed in plants, where certain plants release chemicals that can inhibit the germination or growth of neighboring plants.
 
• This phenomenon plays a significant role in **agriculture, horticulture, and forestry**, as it can affect crop yields and plant biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Allotropy**

 
 
• Allotropy refers to the existence of two or more different forms of an element in the same physical state.
 
• Examples include carbon, which can exist as diamond, graphite, and graphene.
 
• Allotropic forms have different physical properties and chemical behaviors.
 
 
 
• **Allopathy**
 
 
• Allopathy is a term used to describe the mainstream medical use of pharmacologically active agents or physical interventions to treat or suppress symptoms or pathophysiologic processes of diseases or conditions.
 
• It is often contrasted with homeopathy, a different system of medicine.
 
 
 
• **Allelomorph**
 
 
• Allelomorph, now commonly referred to as an allele, is one of two or more versions of a gene that are found at the same place on a chromosome.
 
• Alleles can result in different traits, such as eye color or blood type.
 
• The combination of alleles that an individual has is known as their genotype.
